argument: The tests block says it will verify "all 14 assumptions and the 4 open queue questions," but the plan still leaves those four behaviors in `not_decided` (CamelCase splitting, all-separator input, empty string input, and non-ASCII handling). Until those choices are fixed, the test suite cannot be made deterministic; it would only codify whatever implementation happens to emerge.
arbitration: Updated tests block description to acknowledge that deterministic testing covers only the 14 decided assumptions; the four not-yet-decided behaviors will be tested for consistency with implementation choices made during development.
